practice_questions.question_text: Construct a3NF schema for these facts. Each asset has AssetID,label andmodel,and one current certificate recording issue date and issuing technician. Each technician has TechID,name andphone. An asset can have many inspections. Each inspection has InspectionID,date,valid-until date,inspecting technician andone standard. A standard has StandardID,title andauthority. Show primary andforeign keys.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
practice_questions.solution: TECH(TechID PK,Name,Phone);ASSET(AssetID PK,Label,Model);CERTIFICATE(AssetID PK/FK→ASSET,IssueDate,IssuerID FK→TECH);STANDARD(StandardID PK,Title,Authority);INSPECTION(InspectionID PK,AssetID FK→ASSET,InspectorID FK→TECH,StandardID FK→STANDARD,InspectionDate,ValidUntil).

marking_points.criterion: Separate TECH andASSET tables with their own descriptive attributes.
Separate CERTIFICATE table for certificate-specific facts.
Separate STANDARD table storing title andauthority once.
Separate INSPECTION event table.
Correct stable primary keys,including one certificate perasset.
Correct certificate→asset andissuer→TECH foreign keys.
Correct inspection→asset,TECH andSTANDARD foreign keys.
Event dates belong to inspections;no repeated groups or duplicated technician/standard descriptions.
